name: roll thoracic spine lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the thoracic spine. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back, arms crossed.
Place the roller under the thoracic spine and let your body weight settle onto it.
Lift your hips and roll up and down the upper back.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
